attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole notice of him is one sentence: he was martyred by drowning, having been thrown into the sea. The page gives no country, no century, no emperor and no hymn, so the folder is marked by its day. None of the four men of this name the corpus already keeps is on this day, and the page says nothing that would join him to any of them. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
